task: Collect accepted-context full-vocabulary logits from the native Qwen3.8-Flash-Next pack on Strix without disturbing the resident embedding service.

implementation.format: Two little-endian int32 values [vocab_size, row_count], followed by float32 full-vocabulary rows.
implementation.sidecar: PATH.windows.tsv with round, position, window size, row, input token, argmax, and accepted draft count.
implementation.semantics: Emit only verify-window rows 0..accepted, bounded by max-new. Rejected speculative rows are omitted because their conditioning can leave the committed target trajectory.

validation.input_chain: The first input is prompt token 511; every later input equals the prior emitted argmax.
validation.embedding_service: 127.0.0.1:1236 remained resident before and after; pid 7228 used about 2538 MiB.

checks.command: cmake -S . -B build-collector -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/bin/g++-13 -DCMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER=/usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc -DSTRATA_ENABLE_CUDA=ON -DSTRATA_NATIVE_EXPERTS=ON -DSTRATA_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=120 -DSTRATA_GGML_DIR=/home/kearm/Strata/build/plugin-check/_deps/strata_llamacpp-src && cmake --build build-collector --target strata -j12
checks.scope: Dedicated SM120 CUDA build in a separate Strix worktree.
Host-safe repository gate at base 240489ee with the collector diff.

checks.command: Full header, finite, argmax, sidecar, position, input-chain, and service-occupancy validation on the 512-row bank.

non_claims: This is Flash-Next logits collection, not Qwen3.8-27B DFlash2 training data.
It does not prove a Flash-Next-specific drafter/trainer adaptation, QAT improvement, or live acceptance result.
The first cold dedicated-binary invocation paid one-time CUDA initialization; only the warm steady-state timing is reported as collection cost.
A row-0-only 356-row intermediate file was superseded and is not a training bank.
